Content: MemorySmith now supports persistent markdown-backed pages stored in Data/Pages as a sibling to Data/Memories and Data/Graph. FilePageService provides list, search, get, save, delete, and Markdig HTML rendering. Page assets under Data/Pages/assets are served from /page-assets so markdown images and browser-supported audio/video can be embedded. The /pages UI is separate from memory search and /api/pages exposes page CRUD, search, and rendered HTML.
Title: Markdown Pages Current State
